what_the_shipped_behaviour_did_wrong: PLATE_TOL = 0.028 is a BUILD tolerance -- it drives the drag loop toward the middle of the mat with margin, and firing it early is free because there is more episode left to fix a miss. It was also being used as the trigger for the END-OF-EPISODE look-back, where there is no episode left. On seed 3 that fired on a plate at 34.9 mm, already inside the scorer's 50 mm bar, and the look-back's own descent and pinch pushed it to 52.9 mm -- outside -- after which all five drag waypoints left it at 52.9 mm, unmoved, because the hook had missed the rim. evidence/mug_shunt.json, seed 3 block_marks, has the waypoint-by-waypoint record.
measured_value_of_the_look_back_before_t: 0 for 2 on the seeds where it mattered. Seed 9: fired, moved the plate 0.0 mm across twelve waypoints. Seed 3: fired, destroyed a placement that was already scoring.
not_claimed: This does not make task_success non-zero. spoon_placed is 0/10 and is untouched, so no seed has all five.
This does not fix seed 9's plate, which is lost during the mug section between t=70.7 and t=165.5. That loss is measured and unfixed.
